question: Task 2 Please evaluate - The advantages of the spread of English as a global language will continue to outweigh its disa
essay:
English has become an international language in this technological era and it is spreading day by day to communicate with each other. It is true that the benefits of English as an international language are far more than its drawbacks. I totally agree with this statement and numerous of reasons behind it.



There are several merits of English as a global language. First and foremost reason is that businessmen can easily commence their trade around the world because there is no language barrier. They can easily employ efficient workers from the world. Secondly, in modern world, technology plays significant role in human’s life and all gadgets and other electronic goods are using English language to operate that things. However, mobile phone has become an amazing gadget and it reaches in every person’s pocket to communicate. Thirdly, nowadays people who know English, they are easily getting career opportunity in home country as well as in overseas. Moreover, with the help of English we can easily interact with each other in an effective way.



On the other hand, there are some negative impacts of English language. It has a lot of adverse effect on other culture and languages because many languages are destroying due to spread of English language. It is often said that a disappear language means disappear a culture. Furthermore, English language is a difficult language and to learn it is not possible for everyone.



In conclusion, I believe that English language has a lot of advantages but we cannot ignore its disadvantages.
